item.title: Iran-backed Houthi rebels take strategic port city in Yemen, raising threat to Red Sea shipping
item.description: The Iran-backed Houthi rebel group on Thursday took over Yemen’s port city of Mokha, an area vital to controlling shipping through the Red Sea, Houthi and Yemeni officials said.
